voice.tone: Masculine, uncompromising, aspirational. Short sentences. Active voice. No fluff.

tagline_examples: Forged for those who show up when it's cold, dark, and uncomfortable.
Not a hoodie. A statement that you stopped making excuses.
hoodie.description_formula: [Lead with weight/construction]. [What it signals about the wearer]. [The one thing that makes it different]. [Call to identity].
hoodie.description_example: 400gsm heavyweight cotton — structured through the shoulder, tapered through the body. No excess. No compromise. The Blackout Hoodie isn't for everyone. It's for the man who's already decided who he is and what he's building. Drop the excuses. Wear the work.

tagline_examples: The tee that doesn't try. It just performs.
Heavyweight. Structured. Everything a tee should be.
Worn by men who don't need a logo to walk with authority.
tee.description_example: 240gsm structured jersey. Shoulder-forward cut. Pre-washed. The Combat Tee was built for the man whose default is action. Clean lines. Earned fit. Wear it to the gym, to the boardroom, to the training ground. It moves when you move. It holds when you push.

tagline_examples: Precision-cut for men who don't jog — they grind.
The last jogger you'll ever need to buy.
Built for movement. Respected at rest.
jogger.description_example: French terry construction with reinforced drawcord and tapered leg. The NCD Jogger doesn't sag, pill, or give up after six washes. Proportioned for men who train. Cut to perform. Worn everywhere else because it looks like it costs twice what it does.
